name: Beetle
description: A small, hard-shelled insect with sturdy legs and antennae. It scuttles with purpose, often gleaming in metallic colors.

name: Crocodile
description: A massive, armored reptile with powerful jaws and a stealthy, low-slung body. It lurks in water, ready to launch explosive ambushes with a swift lunge.

name: Dove
description: A gentle bird with soft feathers and a cooing call. It soars gracefully through the air, often seen as a symbol of peace and harmony.

name: Eagle
description: A fierce bird of prey with sharp talons and keen vision. It flies high above, scanning for prey with intense focus, before diving with unmatched speed and precision.

name: Floating Eye
description: A hovering orb of flesh, bristling with tendrils and stalks. Its gaze is unsettling, filled with cold, alien intelligence.

name: Floating Seed
description: A small, round seed with a helix-like appendage. It just shuffles about, searching for fertile ground.

name: Golem
description: A small, compact figure of dense stone and clay. Despite its size, it is incredibly tough and unyielding, moving with steady purpose, driven by an inner force.

name: Holy Tree
description: A small bonsai tree not taller than the average human. Despite its unassuming appearance, these trees belong to an almost extinct ancient species of sentient trees.

name: Senko
description: A divine celestial kitsune dedicated to nurturing and pampering the guild. Unlocks all traits immediately at Level 1.
exclusiveDescription: Empowers guild healing by +(0.6% × Level) as a global multiplier. All traits are active from Level 1.

name: Lizard
description: A small reptile with agile limbs and darting eyes. It scurries nimbly over rocks and through foliage, quick to flick its tongue and bask in the sun.

name: Mosquito
description: A tiny, buzzing insect with needle-like mouthparts. It flits through the air with an annoying persistence, always seeking a warm-blooded host to siphon from.

name: Owl
description: A nocturnal bird with large, forward-facing eyes and a round face. It glides silently on wide wings, its haunting hoot echoing through the darkness.

name: Kiara
description: An immortal phoenix born from eternal flames. With radiant warmth and vibrant spirit, she rises anew each time she falls.
exclusiveDescription: Each combat turn: 0.15% × Level chance to revive/protect fallen allies (1 + floor(Level / 50) allies).

name: Rat
description: A quick, wiry rodent with sharp teeth and twitching whiskers. It scurries in the shadows, scavenging for scraps and finding its way into the smallest crevices.

name: Red Wolf
description: Rare wolf sometimes found roaming the forests looking for prey. It has a timid and elusive nature, but it is also extremely loyal.

name: Rockling
description: A squat, rocky creature covered in jagged stone plates. It shuffles slowly, grinding against the earth, its mineral-rich body blending seamlessly with crags and boulders.

name: Squirrel
description: A sleek, agile rodent with sharp claws and a bushy tail. It moves with a silent grace, watching its surroundings with a mix of curiosity and calculated intent. Loves to eat nuts.

name: Tarantula
description: A large, hairy spider with eight watchful eyes and thick, bristling legs. It moves slowly and deliberately, ready to pounce or retreat into the shadows.

name: Tentacle Tangle
description: A writhing, pulsating clump of rubbery tendrils, constantly coiling and twisting. It slithers with unsettling grace, its searching limbs probing for anything to grasp.

name: Tesseract
description: A shimmering, geometric construct that defies conventional shapes. It twists in and out of itself, folding space in mind-bending ways, giving glimpses into other dimensions.

name: Thing from the Abyss
description: A shadowy, amorphous entity with flickering, spectral limbs and piercing, formless eyes. Very small for abyssal horror standards, but it still radiates cold dread.

name: Tree Frog
description: A small, bright green amphibian with powerful legs. Its sharp, resonant croak echoes through the forests, and it has a voracious appetite for anything it can swallow.

name: Walking Bush
description: A dense, thorny shrub with rustling leaves that move on their own. It scuttles across the ground, roots writhing like legs, driven mostly by curiosity.
